title: Revert line wrapping (#29, #30)
body:
**Intent:** the maintainer would rather revert than fix forward. [#29](https://github.com/hartz89/docent/pull/29) merged on green CI before its review, which requested changes for a real bug. [#30](https://github.com/hartz89/docent/pull/30) then fixed that bug forward. This undoes both, and the long-line problem moves to a Biome plugin that keeps our own source within 100 characters.

**Behavior change:** the code view no longer wraps long lines, and the "Wrap long lines" toggle is gone. This is exactly the state after [#28](https://github.com/hartz89/docent/pull/28): `git diff 1f80e34` on this branch is empty.

**Tier 1:** `apps/web` and the e2e step #29 added.

**Known gaps:** sideways scrolling returns for long lines, mostly Markdown, which Biome doesn't lint. The plugin and the prompt rewrap follow after [#21](https://github.com/hartz89/docent/pull/21).
